topic: What antenna design considerations optimize ground station visibility during short service windows in LEO constellations?
consensus_response: Optimizing antenna design for LEO constellations involves beamforming, polarization, and frequency selection. Phased arrays and digital beamforming enhance signal directionality and mitigate interference, while hybrid beamforming balances performance and resource efficiency. Beam hopping techniques dynamically adjust beam patterns to prioritize high-demand users.
reference_context: LEO constellations require multiple satellites for global coverage, with orbit altitude and inclination impacting service zones and subscriber visibility.
